title: Alpine Macro王岩：新兴市场金融板块迎来配置窗口？
speaker: Yang Wang

segments.en: I mean, maybe a bit of a separate story, but we have been seeing the past couple of sessions last week, especially on the hung saying the finance stocks getting hard hit because of some of these elevated yield financial condition concerns.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，这可能有点不同，但我们看到上周过去几个交易日，尤其是在香港市场，金融板块受到严重打击，因为一些关于收益率上升和金融状况的担忧。

segments.en: Broadly speaking, if we talk about EM, EM financial, the relative performance of EM financials historically has had a very tight correlation with the monetary cycle in EM.
segments.zh: 总体而言，如果我们谈论新兴市场金融板块，历史上新兴市场金融板块的相对表现与新兴市场的货币周期有非常紧密的相关性。

segments.en: So this is actually quite ironic if central banks are tightening that on margin, it's good news for banks because that supports their profit margin, their net interest margin.
segments.zh: 所以这实际上相当讽刺，如果央行在边际上收紧，这对银行来说是好消息，因为这支持了它们的利润率，它们的净息差。

segments.en: So at the expense of corporate borrowers, corporate household borrowers, so actually one in the tightening cycle, financials tend to do better.
segments.zh: 所以以企业借款人、企业家庭借款人为代价，实际上在紧缩周期中，金融板块往往表现更好。

segments.en: So at this point actually, we think it makes sense to increase exposure to EM financials because now on margin, EMs under banks are moving towards a tightening cycle.
segments.zh: 所以实际上在这一点上，我们认为增加对新兴市场金融板块的敞口是有道理的，因为现在边际上，新兴市场的银行正朝着紧缩周期移动。

segments.en: And over time, this could lead to some kind of tailwind for EM financials.
segments.zh: 随着时间的推移，这可能为新兴市场金融板块带来某种顺风。
